regions.merged_text: Loyd Walker - 16 - no religion but kindly disposed, threatened with total blindness by explosion in little laboratory at home. Doctors had no hope of ever seeing again. - you were asked on Oct. 31 - 2 weeks To-day to pray for him and that day after being enrolled in Ser. Masses ... Now they wonder that both eyes will be saved. - pray on. He is to have another operation to-morrow - enrolled again.

regions.merged_text: Ed. McQuillan - 13 - Threatened with another major operation on lungs; has had one already and at least fifteen minors during last 8 yrs. Boy inhaled timothy - hay-seed. Some of it remained in lungs causing ulcers like T.B. Enrolled To-day N.B. - Feb. 19 - '35 - Boy's father reports no operation further necessary. Boy improving O.K.
